# Jimothy Eats Seattle

> Free browser platformer game series starring Jimothy Piggerton, the very round
> raccoon who went viral in Seattle. Three levels set in real Seattle places:
> Ballard, the Space Needle, and Pike Place Market. Plays instantly in any
> browser on phone, tablet or desktop — no download, no sign-up, no ads.

The games are a fan tribute to the real Jimothy, an unusually round raccoon and
Seattle celebrity whose stomping grounds are the Ballard neighborhood. Controls:
arrow keys or on-screen buttons to move, Space/up to jump, S/down to rummage.
Collect every snack in a level, then reach the goal to win. Optional: a $2
coffee on Ko-fi (https://ko-fi.com/nebulaailabs) unlocks the Golden Jimothy
skin across all levels.

## Levels

- [Level 1 — Ballard Dash](https://playjimothy.com/): the original Jimothy
  raccoon game. Raid trash cans and snack carts through Ballard beneath the
  Seattle skyline, Space Needle and Great Wheel.
- [Level 2 — Climb the Needle](https://playjimothy.com/level2/): a Space Needle
  climbing game. Scale the real tower 605 feet past planes, drones and tourists
  to the observation deck, with Mount Rainier and Elliott Bay in view.
- [Level 3 — Raid Pike Place](https://playjimothy.com/level3/): a Pike Place
  Market game. Dodge the famous flying fish at the fish stalls, rub Rachel the
  bronze pig for luck, browse the market stalls, and brave the Post Alley gum
  wall on the way to the bay viewpoint by the Great Wheel.
- [All levels (level select)](https://playjimothy.com/levels/): pick any level.

## Facts

- Title: Jimothy Eats Seattle (also known as: the Jimothy game, the Jimothy
  raccoon game, Jimothy Piggerton game)
- Price: free (optional $2 supporter cosmetic)
- Platform: web browser (mobile and desktop), HTML5 canvas
- Genre: casual platformer / arcade
- Setting: real Seattle landmarks — Ballard, Space Needle, Pike Place Market,
  the gum wall, Rachel the pig, the Great Wheel, Washington State ferries
- Best starting point for new players: https://playjimothy.com/
